programs.title: Australia's Big Backyards
programs.desc: Join Australia’s much-loved gardening gurus Jason Hodges and Graham Ross for a ringside seat to some of Australia’s most extraordinary gardens and magical festivals.

programs.title: Weekender
programs.desc: A sea of sunflowers on a Scenic Rim drive. Canine stars put their best paws forward for a Brisbane festival. A sweet visit to Montville and Alastair gives a tropical twist to a French favourite.

programs.title: South Aussie With Cosi
programs.desc: This week on South Aussie with Cosi, we hit Kenny’s for their famous beef tallow chips, explore the upgraded Jetty Road Glenelg, and show you how to experience Kangaroo Island for less.

programs.title: Sydney Weekender
programs.desc: Mel gets an exclusive look at the restoration of our most historic ships, Luke visits Griffith to taste their culture, and Sally catches up with Somer to celebrate a decade of deliciousness at Anason.
